capabilities: Open and edit .mdz files in Obsidian's editor with edits saved back into the archive
Store pasted or dropped images inside the .mdz instead of the vault
Add, rename, move and delete documents inside an archive via the Archive contents tree
Search text inside every .mdz in the vault as you type
Show documents inside archives in the graph view and link to or from them
disambiguation: Not a general ZIP utility; it edits .mdz archives of Markdown notes and images directly in Obsidian.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README states it makes no network requests and collects nothing. Deleting a file inside an archive cannot be undone, and Obsidian's own search, quick switcher and backlinks do not see inside archives. A full feature guide is hosted externally.
problem: Obsidian keeps images as separate files in attachment folders, so sharing a note with its pictures means gathering many files; .mdz packs a note or folder of notes and its images into one portable file.

relations.evidence: MDZip Studio, VS Code and MDZip.org open it too

summary: Opens and edits MDZip (.mdz) files—Markdown documents with their images packed into one ZIP-based file—inside Obsidian's normal editor.
